newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 24.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 24.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products.
ADVERTISING, MEDIA & THE INTERNET:
PARIS - French advertising agency Publicis said it formed a top management team of three at its FCA!BMZ network in a move aimed at emphasising the unit's European orientation.(Reuter)

PARIS - French building firms Bouygues, GTM and SGE are creating a clothes brand, Stade de France, to be marketed from next autumn, to maximise the profitability of the World Cup stadium site. (Le Parisien)

LOS ANGELES - Magician David Copperfield claimed $30 million damages from Paris Match magazine for alleging his romance with supermodel Claudia Schiffer was a sham. His defamation suit, filed in Los Angeles Superior Court against the French magazine's publishers and a rival magician, Herbert Becker, said the claim was false. (Reuter)
PARIS - Compagnie Generale des Eaux is planning to sell its 20-percent stake in French billboard advertising company Decaux, sources say. (La Tribune)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:
PARIS - The three competitors in the French mobile phone market sold record numbers of portable phones in June thanks to special offers designed to reach the general public, the firms say.(Reuter)

PARIS - LVMH says merging its wines and spirits business with those of Britain's Guinness and Grand Metropolitan would save 65 million pounds a year. The Financial Times says the British firms are prepared to agree a three-way merger this year. LVMH, nudging up pressure on the two to accept its three-way merger plan, confirms it raised its stake in Grand Metropolitan to 11.05 percent. (Reuter)
PARIS - LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton says it bought Sephora, France's leading perfume and beauty products retailer, for 1.6 billion francs ($260.8 million). (Reuter)

WARSAW - Shares in Polish edible fats maker Kruszwica SA jump on Wednesday after Tuesday's news the Cereol unit of Franco-Italian food group Eridania Beghin-Say agreed to buy a 45 percent stake, traders said. (Reuter)
PEOPLE NEWS:
PARIS - Corinne Bouygues, managing director of TF1 Publicite, the advertising arm of France's biggest private television station, has resigned for personal reasons. (Les Echos, Le Figaro)

PARIS - The appointment of Patrick de Carolis, information director at French private television channel M6, as director of magazine programmes at France 3 depends on talks between France 3 and Jean-Marie Cavada over the future of his prominent current affairs programme, La Marche du Siecle.(Les Echos)
